Muted paper, timber, ink jade, vermilion banners, bronze key patterns, Han eaves, city walls, warships, bamboo slips, and command tallies.
A bustling daylight market becomes a smoky-violet night fair, with Song shops, Rainbow Bridge, Bian River boats, lanterns, carved windows, wisteria, willow, and fine paper-and-stone details.
A clear daytime harbor becomes the recommended violet sunset after dark, linking timber piers, fishing boats, cabins, nets, buoys, a lighthouse, gulls, sea mist, and slow translucent tides.

A humid deep-green rainforest surrounds thatched huts, hide tents, stone totems, ritual altars, campfires, giant vines, orchids, violet berries and crystals, wildlife, smoke, mist, and drifting insects.

Charred cliffs and flowing red lava contrast with underground violet geodes, sulfur smoke, erupting rocks, caves, stone bridges, magma fissures, fire spores, volcanic moss, obsidian, and glowing crystals.

Daylight Gobi sand becomes a violet dusk grotto after dark, linking cave niches, flying ribbons, camels, dunes, murals, silk banners, Crescent Spring, ruined walls, wind chimes, oil lamps, agate, footprints, and desert poplars.
